description_en: Retrieves the managed transform configuration for a site
description_zh: 查询站点托管转换配置
name: GetManagedTransform

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The site version. If version management is enabled for the site, use this parameter to specify the version whose configuration you want to retrieve. The default is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

AddClientGeolocationHeader.description_en:
Indicates whether a header that contains the visitor's geolocation is added. Valid values:

on: Enables this feature.

off: Disables this feature
AddClientGeolocationHeader.description_zh:
添加访问者地理位置标头。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

AddRealClientIpHeader.description_en:
Indicates whether the "ali-real-client-ip" header is added to include the real client IP. Valid values:

on: Enables this feature.

off: Disables this feature
AddRealClientIpHeader.description_zh:
添加包含真实客户端IP的 "ali-real-client-ip" 标头。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭

RealClientIpHeaderName.description_en: The real client IP header name

SiteVersion.description_en: The version of the site for which the configuration is returned
SiteVersion.description_zh: 站点的版本号。开启了版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
